authors: Shanchuan Lin, Linjie Yang, Imran Saleemi, Soumyadip Sengupta
model: Official MobileNetV3 and ResNet50 FP32 ONNX weights and recurrent networks are unchanged. Both models perform human video matting. Portrait and fullbody use MobileNetV3. Precision selects ResNet50 as an alternative model.
checksumProvenance: SHA-256 values are measured from the pinned official release downloads and enforced locally. The upstream release assets have no publisher-provided SHA-256 digest.
implementation: CPU uses the original graph and TypeScript pixel conversion. DirectML uses derived byte-input/BGRA-output graphs with exact byte normalization and quantization, foreground/alpha and nonfinite validation on the GPU. Recurrent states remain FP32 and survive same-model GPU-to-CPU fallback. Uses the existing pinned ONNX Runtime 1.31.1 native binaries.
